notes: MANOVA on the pottery chemical-composition data: PROC GLM with a CLASS/MODEL/CONTRAST/ESTIMATE/LSMEANS/MANOVA block, followed by the simultaneous-CI DATA step that already used inline DATALINES in the source. All 26 rows of data/pottery.txt inlined via DATALINES in place of the original INFILE path (the original file is small enough to use in full). Added a PROC PRINT of the intervals dataset at the end so the bundle's listing shows the computed confidence intervals -- the source script computed them but never printed them.
